instruction_summary: Policy-rules-only update of Immervoll-Kleven-Kreiner-Saez (EJ 2007): hold the paper's 1998 cell weights and closed-form formulas fixed, recompute tau and participation tax rates from EUROMOD J2.54+ on hypothetical households for 2009-2026 across 14 EU countries, and ask whether the in-work-transfer-beats-demogrant ranking still holds and how bottom-decile participation tax rates moved.

steps.description: Gate 0: install .NET 8 runtime + euromod 0.4.0; smoke-test AT_2025
steps.command: dotnet-install --runtime dotnet --channel 8.0; uv pip install euromod==0.4.0 pandas; python gate0_smoke.py

steps.description: Gates 1-2: reproduce paper Table 2a through copied welfare_core.py (A2 fix)
Headline EUROMOD runs: 14 countries x 18 years (less IE 2021) of cell rates tau,a_noUB,a_UB
Fix PTR denominator (labour-cost change, not total household) for working-spouse couples; re-run all
Aggregate to decile profiles, welfare, critical eta; determine V4/q=0 headline regime
Gate 3 (OECD TaxBEN levels, no-UB + UB) and gate 3b (change gate) for 14 countries
Gate 3c (MTR add-on, tau validation) and gate 4 (J2.54+ beta vs J2.0+ stable, 2025)
steps.command: python gate3c.py <CC> <root>; python run_headline.py <CC> --variant gate4_j20 --zip J2.0+

steps.description: Probes: earnings variable, employer-SSC ratios, IE hours, DE Midijob

key_results.headline_regime: V4 (q=0, no-UB panel) — 7 of 14 countries triggered no meaningful UB
key_results.Psi_w_lt_Psi_d_2026: 8 of 10 stable countries (ranking flipped to demogrant in IE, SE)
key_results.central_finding: Bottom-decile PTR/MTR approach 100% under 2009+ rules in single-earner hypothetical households (traps), destabilising the paper's closed-form Psi; decile profiles and bottom-quintile PTR change are the robust results

comparison_to_original.quantity: Countries with Psi_w < Psi_d (in-work transfer cheaper)
comparison_to_original.note: paper's core qualitative finding survives where computable; flipped to demogrant in IE, SE
set changed; mixes method/q-regime, see report
DK bottom-quintile PTR fell 24pp but Psi unstable due to residual traps
hypothetical single-earner traps; method break at 1998->2009 disclosed

artifacts: results/report inputs: rates_cells.csv, rates_deciles.csv, welfare_by_year.csv, critical_eta_by_year.csv
deviations: V4 (q=0) is the headline (pre-declared rule): 7 of 14 countries triggered no meaningful unemployment benefit in the hypothetical households.
a_UB uses direct construction (= HHoT_un switch) rather than the NRR add-on (which models an ~18-month exhausted spell); spouse earnings preserved (verified).
Psi (E2/E3/E4) reported only for the 10 'stable' countries in 2026 because bottom-decile traps (PTR/MTR ~ 1) destabilise the paper's closed form; this instability is itself the central finding.
Strict OECD level-validation (gate 3 no-UB) passes only for singles (V = {DK, FR}); the headline change is validated via gate 3b over V_delta = {DK, FI, FR, LU, NL, SE}.

Variants V3 (dispersion), V5 (rent=20%AW), V6 (one child), lhw=40, and the employer-SSC inversion were NOT executed (cut to protect the headline + all six gates, per the spec's ordering). V1 (CTR fixed) computed, headline unchanged (8/10).
Data fix: staged earn_nt_net 2024 values were monthly not annual (corrected and verified); 2026 AW uprated by the country XML $f_yem index.
EL and IT produce no employer SSC (ils_sicer=0) -> gross basis, flagged. IE 2021 missing (no hhot config), not interpolated. DE Midijob probe inconclusive (test points not aligned to XML band).
